evaluation_scope: Development-set prompt experiments on the production evidence-review component. Labels are AI-proposed, pending human review.

changes.change: Distinguish a proposed diagnostic from an asserted observed outcome. Accept grounded sentinel/negative/prerequisite checks without demanding the exact test appear in the source.
changes.risk: May retain an unsupported remedy mistaken for a diagnostic; monitor all 43 negative controls.

changes.change: Add an explicit boundary and compound-clause audit without silently repairing a finding in the reviewer explanation.
changes.target: Wrong comparison strictness and condition scope
changes.risk: Overly literal checking can increase false rejections of faithful paraphrases.

changes.change: Accept narrow static consequences and explicit test/fixture attestations at their stated scope, retaining the prohibition on runtime or external-product extrapolation.
changes.target: Over-rejection of code and fixture observations
changes.risk: May over-generalize test artifacts into product facts; monitor mock-versus-live and provenance controls.

attribution_limit: Variants are cumulative, use one real model call per case, and run on the same development dataset. Incremental deltas are observed associations, not isolated causal effects; serving nondeterminism remains possible.
